eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Ten
subtitle: Lesson 84 · Performance Tuning

eyebrow: The classic accident — no ON at all
code:
-- BUG: missing the ON clause entirely
SELECT p.Name, sod.OrderQty
FROM Production.Product AS p,
     Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod;
caption: No join condition — SQL Server pairs EVERY product with EVERY order line.

eyebrow: The subtler version — a fake ON clause
code:
-- BUG: ON exists, but doesn't relate the tables
INNER JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
    ON p.Name IS NOT NULL;
-- true for almost every row
caption: Looks correct — but evaluates to TRUE for nearly every combination.
